rv.q: I wouldn’t be at all surprised if Jersey Boys, co-written by Rick Elice and Marshall Brickman (with this production directed by Des McAnuff), runs for another 20 years.
What makes this opening show for the 2026-2027 M&T Bank Broadway in Syracuse season particularly special is its longevity: this 'Jersey Boys,' is the 20th anniversary tour.
A fabulous evening showcasing exceptional talent—and a show that is well worth seeing!

cn.t: Critics praise Jersey Boys as a stellar jukebox musical that seamlessly weaves The Four Seasons' iconic hits into the group's compelling rise-to-fame story, with the show proving its enduring appeal 20 years on.
